أستصهن (form X)
# أَسْتَصْهِنُ (ʔastaṣhinu) /ʔas.tasˤ.hi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# أَسْتَصْهِنَ (ʔastaṣhina) /ʔas.tasˤ.hi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# أَسْتَصْهِنْ (ʔastaṣhin) /ʔas.tasˤ.hin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
